records.operation: Aggregate nine numeric features per explicitly supplied group.

parameters.heights: Aligned finite strictly positive real heights.
parameters.descriptors: Peak-by4 real matrix; NaN allowed only in first2 columns.

records.validity_bounds: Exclude next-neighbor ratio>.33333 with height>50. Count quadrants0/2, all, and1/3. For0/2 compute height mean/sample std and means of previous ratio,next ratio,absolute opposite offset,sawtooth MSE. Missing groups and undefined summaries retain NaN; reject infinity.
records.outputs: Measurement-by9 float matrix in the declared feature order.
records.plain_limits: Summarize grouped peak records with fixed numeric rules.
records.reuse: Group identities are arbitrary numeric indexes; thresholds and feature definitions are explicit recipe policy.

seed_fields.description: Explicit aggregate operation for qualified runtime composition.

records.operation: Convolve adjacent amplitude differences with a uniform kernel and trim both ends.

parameters.heights: At least2 finite nonnegative descending real amplitudes.

records.validity_bounds: Full convolution with ones(width)/width, then [trim:-trim]; trim0 retains everything. Empty trimmed output is valid; reject nonfinite arithmetic.
records.outputs: Finite gradient vector, possibly empty.
records.plain_limits: Smooth changes in ranked magnitudes.
records.reuse: Domain-independent numeric sequence operation; smoothing controls are explicit.

seed_fields.description: Explicit amplitude gradient operation for qualified runtime composition.

records.operation: Construct first-order baseline subtraction filter arguments.

parameters.retention: Finite numeric scalar in[0,1], excluding bool.

records.validity_bounds: Return b=[a,-a], denominator=[1,-a], independent float64 input, axis=-1 and initial delay[-a*x0]. No filtering occurs here.
records.outputs: Five ordered arguments for the qualified linear filter.
records.plain_limits: Prepare a recursive baseline filter with explicit retention.
records.reuse: Domain-independent signal operation with an explicit initial-state convention.

seed_fields.description: Explicit baseline arguments operation for qualified runtime composition.

records.operation: Copy a filtered vector and set its first value to zero.
records.validity_bounds: Copy to float64, then overwrite index0. Does not authenticate filter coefficients, input provenance or the initial state.
records.outputs: Independent residual vector.
records.plain_limits: Apply the initial zero-residual convention.
records.reuse: Generic numeric boundary; pair with matching filter arguments when reconstructing baseline subtraction.

seed_fields.description: Explicit baseline residual operation for qualified runtime composition.

records.operation: Collect peak records through nine explicitly supplied numeric callables.

parameters.values: Finite real sample-by-signal matrix with samples>=3 and complete consecutive triples.
parameters.coefficients: Aligned finite coefficient vector from the same signal matrix.
parameters.arguments_function: Qualified callable(values,retention) returning five filter arguments.
parameters.rank_function: Qualified callable(residual,positions) returning ranked positions and heights.

records.validity_bounds: Visit every column serially; group index=column//3. Check descriptor and phase alignment. Shape checks and callability do not authenticate semantics or matching provenance. Control value validation is delegated to qualified operations.
records.outputs: Aligned group indexes, heights, peak-by4 descriptors, quadrants and measurement count.
records.plain_limits: Apply explicit numeric operations to every signal and collect ordered triples.
records.reuse: Recipe grouping policy; injected numeric operations remain independently selectable.

seed_fields.description: Explicit collect operation for qualified runtime composition.

records.operation: Encode the qualified final output as finite JSON-compatible values.

parameters.trained: Matching result dictionary with probability and signal-decision arrays,threshold,models,scope.

records.validity_bounds: Convert arrays to lists and retain exactly five fields. Require finite JSON; do not independently validate shapes, probability ranges, integer labels or provenance.
records.outputs: Dictionary of probabilities,signal_decisions,threshold,models,scope in original query order.
records.plain_limits: Return the final numeric output and declared limitations.
records.reuse: Serialization boundary; caller must supply qualified result provenance.

seed_fields.description: Explicit encode result operation for qualified runtime composition.

records.operation: Execute every supplied fold and accumulate count-normalized scores.

parameters.training: Nonempty real rank2 features; NaN allowed.
parameters.query: Nonempty real rank2 features of matching width; NaN allowed.
parameters.plans: List of5*repetitions complete disjoint three-way partitions.
parameters.fold_function: Qualified callable with fit_fold signature and output order.

records.validity_bounds: Validate all partitions before fitting; each row must occur3*repetitions in training and repetitions in each heldout. Validate finite[0,1] returned vectors and iteration1..rounds. Execute serially in plan order, averaging query scores per fold and row scores by coverage. Callable authenticity is a graph concern.
records.outputs: Dictionary of query/training/validation/test probabilities, best iterations and model count.
records.plain_limits: Fit every planned model and preserve the averaging order.
records.reuse: Explicit repeated-five-way ensemble policy over generic numeric features.

seed_fields.description: Explicit ensemble operation for qualified runtime composition.

records.operation: Fit a generic-width binary LightGBM model with two early-stopping populations.

parameters.training: Nonempty real rank2 features; NaN allowed, infinity rejected.
parameters.query: Nonempty real rank2 features of matching width; NaN allowed.
parameters.train: Nonempty integer training indexes with both classes.

records.validity_bounds: Three index vectors must be disjoint and cover every training row exactly once. Binary GBDT, rate.01,80leaves, feature/bagging fractions.8, bagging frequency1, deterministic column-wise CPU with one thread. Both heldouts influence binary-logloss early stopping; neither is untouched test evidence.
records.outputs: Train,validation,test,query probability vectors in supplied row order and selected iteration.
records.plain_limits: Fit one full fold with explicit stopping populations.
records.reuse: Domain-independent numeric binary learning with fixed documented hyperparameters; feature width is generic.

seed_fields.description: Explicit fit fold operation for qualified runtime composition.

records.operation: Extract the first positive-frequency real FFT coefficient per column.

parameters.values: Finite real rank2 sample-by-signal matrix with at least3 samples and one column.

records.validity_bounds: Cast to float64 and compute rfft along axis0, index1; reject nonfinite coefficients. Frequency means one cycle per supplied length, without physical time units or a three-column restriction.
records.outputs: Complex coefficient vector aligned to columns.
records.plain_limits: Measure the one-cycle component of each numeric signal.
records.reuse: Domain-independent Fourier projection; caller supplies physical interpretation.

seed_fields.description: Explicit fundamental operation for qualified runtime composition.

records.operation: Compute normalized neighbor, opposite-extremum and sawtooth descriptors.

parameters.positions: Rank1 in-range integer peak positions; empty accepted.
parameters.residual: Nonempty finite real vector with nonzero amplitude at every selected peak.

records.validity_bounds: Actual-length clipped windows. Columns are absolute next/peak, previous/peak, signed opposite-extremum offset subtracting small_radius even at boundaries, and normalized sawtooth MSE. Missing neighbors retain NaN. Require normalized waveform maximum aligned with template maximum; reject infinity.
records.outputs: Float64 peak-by4 descriptor matrix.
records.plain_limits: Describe each peak using local normalized waveform shape.
records.reuse: Numeric waveform operation with explicit template and edge conventions; no grouping or labels.

seed_fields.description: Explicit peak descriptors operation for qualified runtime composition.

records.operation: Assign right-closed phase quadrants relative to a supplied Fourier coefficient.

parameters.positions: Rank1 in-range integer positions; empty accepted.
parameters.coefficient: Finite numeric scalar Fourier coefficient for the same signal.
parameters.length: Python integer>=3 matching the full signal length.

records.validity_bounds: Compute (degrees(2*pi*positions/length+angle(coefficient))+90)%360. Right-closed bins yield0..3; exactly zero yields-1. Matching coefficient provenance is caller responsibility.
records.outputs: Aligned integer quadrant vector.
records.plain_limits: Locate selected positions within the one-cycle phase.
records.reuse: Domain-independent numeric phase policy with an explicit90-degree offset.

seed_fields.description: Explicit phase quadrants operation for qualified runtime composition.

records.operation: Rank supplied candidates by descending absolute residual amplitude.

parameters.positions: At least2 unique in-range integer positions.

records.validity_bounds: Use reversed NumPy argsort of absolute amplitudes; ties follow that implementation, not a stable chronological tie rule.
records.outputs: Aligned ranked position and amplitude vectors.
records.plain_limits: Rank candidate peaks by magnitude.
records.reuse: Generic numeric ranking, independent of signal grouping or labels.

seed_fields.description: Explicit rank peaks operation for qualified runtime composition.

records.operation: Reorder nine features and derive measurement labels from triples.

parameters.training: Nonempty real training-by9 matrix; NaN allowed, infinity rejected.
parameters.query: Nonempty real query-by9 matrix; NaN allowed, infinity rejected.

records.validity_bounds: Copy feature columns in order[2,7,3,4,8,0,6,5,1]; label a measurement positive when any signal is positive. Copy signal labels.
records.outputs: Training features, measurement labels, query features and signal labels.
records.plain_limits: Apply the explicit feature order and triple-label rule.
records.reuse: Recipe adapter; generic-width fitting remains separate.

seed_fields.description: Explicit recipe inputs operation for qualified runtime composition.

records.operation: Construct class-specific random five-way partitions with rotating heldouts.

parameters.labels: Nonempty integer binary vector containing both classes.

records.validity_bounds: RandomState(seed+iteration), assign class1 then class0 independently to integers0..4. Each of5 rotations uses one validation fold, next test fold and remaining3 training folds. Reject empty heldouts or training without both classes.
records.outputs: List of5*repetitions tuples(train,validation,test) of integer index vectors.
records.plain_limits: Construct the full repeated random fold schedule.
records.reuse: Domain-independent binary-label partition policy; not balanced stratified KFold.

seed_fields.description: Explicit repeated folds operation for qualified runtime composition.

records.operation: Apply strict query threshold and repeat the decision across each triple.

parameters.ensemble_result: Matching ensemble dictionary with nonempty finite query probabilities in[0,1].
parameters.selected: Exactly threshold and mcc; finite threshold in[0,1] and finite mcc.

records.validity_bounds: Decision uses strict > although optimizer uses >=. Return a shallow dictionary extension; existing arrays remain shared. Does not independently validate other ensemble fields or prove selected threshold provenance.
records.outputs: Extended dictionary with measurement-by3 decisions, threshold, threshold_fit_mcc and explicit scope.
records.plain_limits: Encode the source decision rule and its evaluation limits.
records.reuse: Recipe decision policy; no independent per-signal probability model.

seed_fields.description: Explicit result operation for qualified runtime composition.

records.operation: Use a cumulative threshold-hit knee and restore chronological order.

parameters.positions: At least2 unique nonnegative integer positions.
parameters.gradient: Finite real rank1 vector, possibly empty.

records.validity_bounds: Count nonconsecutive gradient>threshold hits. Knee is position of count-th hit minus count minus offset, or -offset when too few hits. Apply Python [:knee] unchanged, including negative slicing. No upper position bound or gradient provenance is independently established.
records.outputs: Chronological selected positions, aligned amplitudes and integer knee.
records.plain_limits: Select a prefix using the declared knee rule.
records.reuse: Generic ranked-selection policy with explicit source slicing semantics.

seed_fields.description: Explicit select ranked peaks operation for qualified runtime composition.

records.operation: Maximize grouped MCC over observed probability thresholds.
records.validity_bounds: Group tied probabilities, evaluate decision probability>=threshold at observed values only. Zero denominator gives MCC0; select largest threshold among equal best scores. Does not add an all-negative candidate above the maximum.
records.outputs: Dictionary with threshold and fitted mcc.
records.plain_limits: Select a threshold using the declared MCC and tie rules.
records.reuse: Domain-independent binary threshold optimization; fit scores are not generalization evidence.

records.operation: Align triple signal labels with repeated measurement probabilities.

parameters.training_probabilities: Aligned finite real measurement probabilities in[0,1].

records.validity_bounds: Flatten labels in row order and repeat each measurement score3times. No claim that in-training probabilities are unbiased validation.
records.outputs: Aligned binary labels and probability vectors.
records.plain_limits: Prepare signal-level threshold inputs.
records.reuse: Explicit three-signal policy; threshold optimization remains domain-independent.

seed_fields.description: Explicit threshold inputs operation for qualified runtime composition.

records.operation: Project the five declared training controls in fixed order.

parameters.controls: Dictionary from the validated invocation with repetitions,split_seed,tree_seed,rounds,patience.

records.validity_bounds: No independent value validation; extra keys are ignored and missing keys reject. Downstream fold and fit operations validate numeric bounds.
records.outputs: Five values in declared order.
records.plain_limits: Expose the requested training schedule.
records.reuse: Dictionary projection with explicit key meanings; caller retains validated provenance.

records.plain_limits: Expose in-training probabilities for threshold fitting.
records.reuse: Generic dictionary projection with explicit mutability and provenance requirements.

parameters.payload: Finite JSON dictionary with exactly version=1, training and query. Training has signals, labels, identities; query has signals, identities.

records.validity_bounds: At most64MiB canonical JSON. Finite real sample-by-signal matrices with equal sample counts>=3 and nonempty consecutive triples. Training integer binary labels align as measurements-by3. Nonempty unique opaque identity strings align per measurement and are disjoint between populations. Validate all125 random folds before returning.

records.validity_bounds: Preserve asymmetric directional advancement and plateau midpoints; intersect reflected reverse indexes. Empty output is valid. This is not a symmetric sliding maximum filter.

records.reuse: Domain-independent directional peak algorithm with explicit scan policy.

interfaces.name: b
interfaces.constraints: Nonempty finite rank-one float64 numerator coefficients.

interfaces.name: a
interfaces.constraints: Nonempty finite rank-one float64 denominator coefficients with nonzero first coefficient. SciPy normalizes coefficients by a[0].

interfaces.name: x
interfaces.constraints: Nonempty finite rank-one float64 numeric signal; this is the qualified subset of the wider ArrayLike interface.

interfaces.name: axis
interfaces.constraints: For the qualified rank-one signal use Python integer -1 or 0.

interfaces.name: zi
interfaces.constraints: None for zero initial delay, or finite float64 vector of length max(len(a),len(b))-1 containing initial filter delay state.

interfaces.name: result
interfaces.constraints: Float64 vector with the same shape as x. Direct-form filtering uses supplied delay or zero delay. Final delay state is discarded even when zi is supplied. Arithmetic overflow is not rejected by this provider; callers must check output finiteness when required.

records.operation: Apply a real linear digital filter with explicit numerator, denominator, axis and optional initial delay state.
records.plain_description: Filter a numeric sequence using supplied coefficients and, optionally, a starting delay state. Return the filtered sequence.
records.validity_bounds: Nonempty finite rank-one float64 numerator coefficients. Nonempty finite rank-one float64 denominator coefficients with nonzero first coefficient. SciPy normalizes coefficients by a[0]. Nonempty finite rank-one float64 numeric signal; this is the qualified subset of the wider ArrayLike interface. For the qualified rank-one signal use Python integer -1 or 0. None for zero initial delay, or finite float64 vector of length max(len(a),len(b))-1 containing initial filter delay state. Float64 vector with the same shape as x. Direct-form filtering uses supplied delay or zero delay. Final delay state is discarded even when zi is supplied. Arithmetic overflow is not rejected by this provider; callers must check output finiteness when required.
records.reuse: Domain-independent linear sequence filtering; no power-line, measurement-group, peak or classification semantics.
